items.question: Does Pause apply to a queued run that has not started?
options: Apply it: paused at once, never started until Resume
Leave a queued run to start and pause later

items.question: What does Pause do to a run with an open wait?
options: Keep the wait answerable; park the run paused when it is answered
Refuse the pause while a wait is open

items.question: What does Pause do to a run already paused on the usage window or a usage limit?
options: Replace the reason with operator and drop the resume time
Keep the usage reason and ignore the pause

items.question: What does Resume do while a pause is still pending (step in flight or wait open)?
options: Withdraw the pending pause at once
Answer 409 not-paused until the run parks
Make the operator wait for the park, then resume

items.question: Top-level money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, legal framing)?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
